criteria: results/selection_criteria.md (written before the improvement runs): 1 context evidence > 2 correct behaviour > 3 cited gold > 4 tokens/time

selected_config.retriever: hybrid_rrf (dense embeddinggemma-2 on Day 6 index B + BM25, RRF k=60, 20 candidates each)

decision: Criteria 1 and 2 tie (21/22, 23/24) for the three improvements; criterion 3 picks hybrid (21/21 answered questions cite a gold chunk). It costs ~23% more tokens than dense-orig-early, accepted because cost is criterion 4.
caveats: 24 dev questions: one question = ~4 percentage points; not statistically conclusive.
cited_gold is an automatic proxy; manual citation review still required (e.g. strict q19 answer looks correct but cites a chunk without the exact gold quote).
hybrid's only false abstention is q21, where no config retrieved the right Mau 04 chunk; dense-orig-early 'answered' q21 by citing Mau 05 (p36), i.e. a wrong source.
